original_test_intent: Write a precisely authorized range to FRU device 0 through the raw in-band path, prove exact stored bytes and valid dependent structures, and restore the original image under an approved plan.
original_method: Preserve Storage 0x0a/0x12 and device byte 0x00. Master payload is incomplete, so the Review layer requires project-supplied offset/count/data based on the actual device access mode.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek expands the incomplete Master request but still accepts unresolved shell variables, unsafe access and high-level fru print as readback; that is insufficient for exact byte integrity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After fresh approval, use `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x12 0x00 <offset-lsb> <offset-msb> <approved-data...>` or a target-approved equivalent exactly once, with request construction governed by access mode and full backup.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Device 0, netfn/cmd, original incomplete command, attended time 10 and machine time 5 are preserved; missing bytes are never invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prepare a byte-exact signed-off delta from a complete backup, execute one protected bounded write, validate returned count plus raw readback/checksums and use only the approved restore path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds missing payload, integrity and recovery requirements in the Review layer without modifying Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only FRU comparison is prerequisite/partial evidence and cannot be declared equivalent to successful Write FRU Data coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong offset, access unit, length or checksum can corrupt platform identity and affect asset tracking, service tooling or boot/management consumers; restoration may not reverse cached downstream state.

project_override_considerations: A vendor editor/API may replace raw IPMI only with equivalent byte-range traceability, write/readback and checksum evidence. It must record that raw 0x0a/0x12 remains unverified unless explicitly waived.
expected_evidence: Fresh approval with target/device and exact hex vector
Complete pre-write image and cryptographic hash
Exact affected-range readback and complete post-image hash
Parsed post-write fields/checksums and intended-only delta

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master provides an incomplete destructive request and command-success-only Criteria, while its setup clears evidence. DeepSeek fills placeholders but uses unsafe access and insufficient high-level verification. Review preserves source and explicitly supplies the missing safety/acceptance contract.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The functional target and command family are understood. Exact bytes, backup, write authorization and recovery are execution-readiness inputs; absent inputs prevent execution but not completion of this engineering review.

review_improvement: Prevents arbitrary FRU corruption by requiring a complete immutable backup, byte-exact approved delta, one write, raw readback, structural checksum validation and controlled restore.
independent_technical_reasoning: FRU is structured identity storage, so changing a single field may require coordinated length and checksum bytes. Command completion or decoded `fru print` can hide an unintended raw delta. The only defensible oracle is exact before/after image comparison plus parser/checksum validation, under fresh confirmation and no retry.
